svg.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Slingshot — planning mode (variant level: red dwarf, ringed gas giant)
svg.desc: Planning-mode mockup of a second level: a red dwarf in the centre, a ringed gas giant as the slingshot body, a barren moon, a rocky desert start world and planet X; ship on the start world with the drag arrow at 62 % power, dotted predicted path swinging around the gas giant’s far side toward planet X, HUD with fuel, Launch and telemetry.
